 Follow ‘Sister Wives’ Star Janelle Brown Makes Bold Prediction About New Relationship
 Martin Holmes Fri, October 23, 2026 at 2:39 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Janelle Brown and new boyfriend Pete - TLC YouTube Janelle Brown 's new boyfriend, Pete, hasn't debuted on Sister Wives yet, but the couple is already predicting a bright future together.
 In a recent Instagram video shared Wednesday (October 21), Janelle and Pete are seen in a pair of rocking chairs on the porch. "Beautiful fall afternoon. Rockin with my baby. This is forever," Pete captioned the post.
 "Okay, we're predicting this is us in five years," Pete tells the camera in the clip itself.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Oh no. Let's say 30," Janelle responds.
 Pete replies, "Wait… six years?"
 "30," Janelle answers
 "Oh, my God. 30, okay," Pete agrees while Janelle adds, "In our rocking chairs."
 Janelle was previously married to polygamist Kody Brown , alongside Meri Brown , Christine Brown , and Robyn Brown . TLC's Sister Wives documented the plural marriage, including the breakdown of the relationship over the past few years. Janelle, Meri, and Christine all separated from Kody, leaving Robyn as his only wife.
 During their 30-year relationship, Janelle and Kody had six children: Logan, Madison, Hunter, Garrison, Gabriel, and Savanah. Their son, Garrison, died by suicide in 2024.
 Advertisement Advertisement Janelle went official with her new beau on Instagram back in August. "Some chapters are meant to unfold quietly before they're shared," she captioned a pic of herself hugging Pete. "I wasn't looking. I certainly wasn't expecting you. And somehow, you turned out to be exactly what I didn't know I needed. And it has been pretty wonderful. Everyone please meet Pete."
 A trailer for the currently airing 21st season of Sister Wives teased the start of Janelle and Pete's relationship. In a clip, Janelle hugs a man and says, "Nice to meet you." She follows up in a confessional, saying, "His name is Peter, and there are no red flags. Peter is so nice."
 Fans flooded the latest Instagram post with comments, with many sharing their happiness for Janelle.
 "I'm so happy for you both," wrote one Instagram commenter.
 Advertisement Advertisement "So happy for you, Janelle!!" said another.
 "STAHHHPPP ITTT!! You guys are too cute!! When is the porch swing being installed??" added another.

 Another wrote, "I couldn't be happier for you Janelle. Wishing you and Pete countless years of love and of course, porch sitting."
 "Janelle deserves all the happiness and love," one fan added.
 "Aww I love seeing Janelle happy! Nice work Pete!!" added another.
 "I've never been so happy for someone I didn't know. Love this for you Janelle. Be happy you deserve it," said one commenter.
 Another added, "I met the love of my life when I was fifty. He is not my first love but he is my forever love. Cheers to you and Peter and forever love!"
